rounds.hypotheses: Six predeclared whole-field principles; no hard anchors or fixed margin.
rounds.finding: No initial novel method improves mean IoU over the retained B08 comparator. E01/E02 offer faster but less accurate alternatives.

rounds.hypotheses: Exploit known palette geometry through colour-simplex inversion; confidence-limited coarse correction; shared-covariance linear discrimination; multimodal Gaussian mixtures.
rounds.finding: E08 increases mean IoU, E09 improves both mean IoU and speed over retained B08. Flexible mixtures reduce mean IoU.

rounds.hypotheses: Amortize inverse on a colour lattice; globally calibrate majority constraints; quadratic ridge evidence.
rounds.finding: E11 preserves E08 accuracy within 0.000010 mean IoU and substantially reduces runtime. E12 provides no meaningful gain over E09. E13 is faster but loses accuracy.

rounds.hypotheses: Uncertainty-gated guided posterior regression; explicit coarse-label noise deconvolution.
rounds.finding: E14 adds only 0.000750 mean IoU over E11 while taking about 3.7 times as long; below predeclared 0.001 improvement tolerance. E15 does not improve E11.

rounds.hypotheses: Confidence-weighted logarithmic pooling on a Jensen-Shannon probability graph.
rounds.finding: E16 adds only 0.000047 mean IoU over E11 and is about 4.6 times slower. Second consecutive round without a qualifying Pareto improvement.

stopping: Predeclared practical stopping rule reached after rounds 4 and 5; this does not assert that all possible mathematical innovation is exhausted.
mean_metric: Arithmetic case mean native macro IoU on nine named ROIs, fixed equal 9+19 RGB
